answer: Each identity forges one grafting knife for 75 POA and grafts a single branch onto the ledge orchard; the graft bears fruit only after eight verified waterings of its own sapling, each watering signed by two neighbors. A copied graft withers at inspection, the knife is confiscated, the 75 POA is kept, and the identity is barred five epochs. Ten clones need ten knives, ten saplings, and ten watering logs — 750 POA — and the cost cannot be pooled or reused.
